description: Export padding on the authored bevelled-cube mesh (R-090 P5, decision 100): one fill, BaseColor, Height and User0 (RGB16) field A, SpecularRoughness and Opacity (L8) grey A. PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f: infinite, passthrough, and color, transparent and diffusion at dilation 0, 2 and 8; no dithering; every export step done twice in the session. Probes: L+A and RGB+A (opacity as alpha) under infinite and transparent 2, PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f.
